scientific_target.reference_work: Grant et al., Addressing Divergent Representations from Causal Interventions on Neural Networks, ICLR 2026 Oral
scientific_target.green_advance: apply the unchanged prospective silent-failure decision rule to GPT-2 Greater-Than

candidate_population.temporal_eligibility: the frozen layer-10 MLP structural readout is strictly downstream of every patch site
candidate_population.candidate_rule: immutable tokenizer-only prompt/site universe; no selection using behavior, GREEN, baseline, transport, or downstream endpoint outcomes

analysis_strata.clean_task_valid: prespecified clean-task competence gate; exclusion rate always reported
analysis_strata.high_restoration: ordinary restoration >= 0.8; prespecified analysis stratum, never a replacement universe

clean_task_validity_gate.metric: clean correct-suffix probability mass exceeds incorrect-suffix probability mass

response_evaluation_precision.reason: avoid catastrophic cancellation in finite responses at direction norm 0.001 while evaluating the same frozen checkpoint constants

primary_endpoint.name: sealed_heldout_causal_transport_failure
primary_endpoint.continuous_measure: primary: absolute response RMSE and symmetric normalized response RMSE using max(target RMS, patched RMS, 1e-12) on the sealed endpoint direction panel
primary_endpoint.failure_label: secondary prespecified effect-size label: symmetric normalized response RMSE > 0.20

endpoint_numerical_replay_protocol.role: numerical reproducibility gate only; never a scientific null distribution and never a transport-failure threshold

secondary_endpoint.name: downstream_layer10_mlp_unembedding_projection
secondary_endpoint.role: task-specific downstream output-aligned signal recovery, non-mechanistic; never used to construct GREEN or the primary transport label

replication_requirement.rule: the IOI and Greater-Than settings must use the same GREEN decision rule and analysis thresholds

execution_barrier: No real outcome may run until the Greater-Than universe, direction payloads, endpoints, baselines, analysis code, and hashes are frozen and independently audited.
